Run from source

After building with the platform commands above, run the server and client in separate terminals from the project root.

Start a local server — macOS and Linux

Create a local configuration with writable database and log paths:

cp server/lineclashd.cfg.example ./lineclashd.cfg
./server/lineclashd --config ./lineclashd.cfg

Leave this terminal open. Press Ctrl+C to stop the server. To restart it, run the same command again with the same configuration.

Start the desktop client — macOS and Linux

In another terminal, from the project root:

./clients/gui/lineclash

Add localhost with game port 31457, enter a nickname and password, connect and join a room. A new nickname registers when server registration is enabled. Use Quit or close the window to stop the client.

Administration tool

./server/lineclashd-tool --help

On Windows, use ./server/lineclashd-tool.exe --help. See the server guide for account privileges and administration. See clients and controls for preferences and connection troubleshooting.

Rebuild after changes

Run make -j4 again from the project root. Stop running programs before replacing their binaries. For a clean rebuild, run make clean followed by make -j4. Keep your configuration and database when rebuilding.

Build and run on Windows

Target: native Windows 10/11 x64 using MSYS2 UCRT64. The SDL2 GUI, dedicated server and administration tool build on Windows.

Install MSYS2, open its UCRT64 terminal, update with pacman -Syu (restart the terminal and repeat if requested), then:

pacman -S --needed make git mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-SDL2 mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sqlite3 mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python
git clone https://github.com/kladhest-se/lineclash.git
cd lineclash
make -j4
./clients/gui/lineclash.exe
# In a separate terminal, if hosting locally:
./server/lineclashd.exe

The GUI opens without an extra console window. It saves settings and servers under %APPDATA%\LineClash. The server uses %APPDATA%\LineClash\Server for its default configuration, database and logs, and also accepts --config PATH. Use ./server/lineclashd-tool.exe --help for administration. Windows HTTPS discovery uses WinHTTP; no libcurl runtime is needed.

Stop and restart

Stop the foreground server with Ctrl+C in its terminal. Close the game window to exit the client. Start either executable again with the same command. Connect the GUI to localhost:31457 when using the local server.
